Secret Lair Countdown Kit: Marvel's History of Heroes

Announcements Oct 16, 2026
Wizards of the Coast

The Marvel Universe has brought innumerable stories that continue to inspire us. With so many tales to tell, we wanted to assemble more of Marvel's decades-long history and legacy across a collection of 30 cards in Secret Lair Countdown Kit: Marvel's History of Heroes. You've read their stories, now bring them to your Magic collection when Marvel's History of Heroes launches on November 2, 2026, only on MagicSecretLair.com.

Molten Duplication Fierce Guardianship Timber Protector Vigor Heroic Intervention Devastation Opposition Agent

But what's inside this giant-size compendium of cards? We've got all the details right here, true believers, to help you prepare for this launch. Here's everything you can find in Secret Lair Countdown Kit: Marvel's History of Heroes!

Secret Lair Countdown Kit: Marvel's History of Heroes Details

Price: $199.99 USD

When you open your copy of Secret Lair Countdown Kit: Marvel's History of Heroes, you'll find a wide variety of cards that celebrate stories from across the Marvel Universe. Featuring illustrations from over 30 artists, this is our tribute to the legacy of Marvel's greatest Super Heroes and their foes. It has everything for a Marvel mega-fan. You'll find street-level squabbles, voyages into the cosmos and beyond, and loving homages to the characters that shaped a universe. Each card tells a story—and these are stories you'll want to read again and again.

Each copy of Secret Lair Countdown Kit: Marvel's History of Heroes contains 30 individually packaged Magic cards, each of which represents an era or moment from the history of the Marvel Universe. These cards randomly appear in non-foil, foil, or—when the stars and spells align—surge foil.

Doctor Strange, Master of Magic Beta Ray Bill

There are two cards in this Countdown Kit that may look (pardon the wordplay) strange to you. Doctor Strange, Master of Magic and Beta Ray Bill both appear in Secret Lair Countdown Kit: Marvel's History of Heroes, representing the arcane and godlike corners of the Marvel Universe. These are two uncommon cards from the main set of Magic: The Gathering® | Marvel: Darkhold Destiny. Both cards will be legal in all formats starting with Magic: The Gathering | Marvel: Darkhold Destiny Prerelease events, which begin on April 2, 2027. But the Sorcerer Supreme and Stormbreaker's wielder are hard to keep down, so we're bringing them to you a bit earlier than usual as part of this Countdown Kit.

You can see all 30 cards from Secret Lair Countdown Kit: Marvel's History of Heroes in the drop-down below. We've got hammers made of Uru, stalwart super-soldiers, and all the style and superpowers you love from the Marvel Universe, coming to MagicSecretLair.com on November 2, 2026.
